title: Simultaneous and sensitive quantification of protein and low-molecular-weight persulfides, polysulfides and H2S in biological samples
core_idea: Develop a sensitive LC-MS/MS workflow that chemically traps sulfur atoms (terminal and internal) from H2S, low-molecular-weight persulfides/polysulfides and protein persulfides to enable simultaneous quantification of these species in the same biological sample, with an orthogonal approach to quantify glutathione-derived persulfides for corroboration.
tldr: A method is developed to trap sulfur atoms and use LC-MS/MS to quantify H2S, persulfides, polysulfides and protein persulfidation simultaneously in biological samples, with an orthogonal assay for glutathione persulfides.
